observations.name: Dense commercial frontage and mixed traffic on Dilsukh Nagar Main Road
observations.notes: Six nearby views show a continuous multi-storey commercial block with many signboards, bus-facing frontage, a paved sidewalk used for two-wheeler parking, mature street trees, dense overhead cables and frequent public buses, scooters and motorcycles. This is scene context only: no road width, traffic rate, building height, or complete shop boundaries were measured.

observations.name: Ground-floor shop sign candidates on Dilsukh Nagar Main Road
observations.notes: Across the sequential views, readable or partly readable ground-floor candidates include JOCKEY; FOOT STEPS; D.V. MASTER TAILORS; VIKRAM clothing/garments; RAY FOCUS HOUSE; NEW CELL MART Sales & Service; Union Bank / Union Bank ATM; RAJADHANI THEATRES; BHAWANI SNACKS; KINGS STYLE FOOTWEAR; and SAMSUNG sales/service with MRN MARKETING. The camera chain is continuous, but overlaying signs, trees, buses and indistinct bay divisions prevent a complete reliable unit-by-unit order and exact entrance placement. Candidate names should not be treated as verified business records.
